input.bodyText:
Wes,

The countertop supplier confirmed they can deliver the quartz on June 2. I need you to sign the change order by this Wednesday (May 20) so I can lock in the install crew for June 3-4.

Please review the attached change order ($1,200 upgrade from granite to quartz) and reply with your approval or call me at 555-0198.

— Dave

> Sounds good Dave. Let me think about the quartz vs granite option over the weekend.
>

>> Hi Wes,
>> Quick update on the kitchen reno. The demo is done and plumbing rough-in passed inspection.

input.subject: Updated PTO Policy — Effective June 1
input.bodyText:
Team,

Please review the updated PTO policy effective June 1, 2026. Key changes:

- Carryover limit increased from 5 to 10 days
- Minimum notice for PTO requests over 3 days: 2 weeks
- New sick leave documentation requirement for absences > 3 consecutive days

Full policy: https://hr.internal/pto-policy-2026

Questions? Reach out to your HR business partner.

Best,
HR Team
